meta.title: TraceCart — Find it. Get it there.
meta.description: Tell us the tool or equipment you need, even if you don't know its name: we find it, buy it and deliver it. Already have the goods? We move them. One delivered price.

hero.eyebrow: Find the tools you need. Get them delivered.
hero.titleBefore: What if the tool you need
hero.subtitleRest: the tools, equipment and parts you're looking for, or move the goods you already have.
hero.imageAlt: A tool handed over at the door, seen from below against a bright sky
hero.cardBody: Built to find the right tool and get it to you on a date you can plan around.

finder.title: What are you looking for?
finder.body: Describe it in your own words or send a photo, even if you don't know its name. A person replies within 4 working hours with options and a delivered price.

trust.text: Trusted by {customers}+ workshops, clinics, builders and farms across {corridors} corridors

pov.before: Most suppliers sell what they have in stock. Most forwarders sell a truck.
pov.accent: We start from what you need,
pov.after: find the right tool, and bring it to your door for one price.
pov.team: One person follows your request from the first message to delivery. No catalogue to dig through, no five suppliers to chase.

services.eyebrow: From the first search to your door
services.title: What are you looking for today?

sourcing.title: Find the right tool
sourcing.body: A photo, a part number or a few words is enough. We identify the product, compare suppliers and check it's the right one before you pay.
sourcing.imageAlt: A coordinator checking a tool at a supplier

freight.title: Transport
freight.body: Already have the goods? We pick them up and move them by sea, rail or road, with the carrier that fits the load and the date.
freight.imageAlt: A truck loaded at a consolidation hub

customs.title: Customs and paperwork
customs.body: Duties estimated up front, documents ready before the border, broker fees shown apart. If you clear customs yourself, you don't pay us for it.
customs.imageAlt: A broker with documents at a land border

tracking.title: Delivery you can follow
tracking.body: Each step as it happens, an honest arrival date, and photographed proof at the door.

results.title: Found, bought, delivered.
results.subtitle: Every request starts with what you need and ends with a signature. Here's the last twelve months.
results.borderCaption: Median time to a confirmed product: 29 h → 17 h
results.savingLabel: Average saving vs. buying the same tool locally

construction.summary: Asked for “the grey tile glue the Turkish builders use”. We identified the brand, bought 6.2 t from the maker and delivered it to Niamey.
construction.imageAlt: Pallets of tile adhesive being unloaded

clinic.summary: 400 glucometers the clinic had already bought, checked as medical devices, cleared in two days and delivered to N'Djamena.
clinic.imageAlt: Boxes of medical devices in a clinic store room

agri.summary: Sent us a photo of a worn pump. We found the exact model at the manufacturer, landed it at Antofagasta and trucked it to Santa Cruz.
agri.imageAlt: Irrigation pumps installed in a field

hardware.quote: I sent a photo of a drill bit I couldn't name. Two days later I had the exact one, at a price that already included delivery.

clinic.name: [Name B]
clinic.quote: They checked our devices before quoting and had the papers ready at the border. Nothing sat in a warehouse waiting for us.

ngo.name: [Name C]
ngo.quote: We needed generators nobody sold locally. They came back with three options, we picked one, and it arrived on the date they gave us.

agri.name: [Name D]
agri.quote: One person, one price. We stopped juggling three suppliers and a spreadsheet to get pumps inland.

footer.stayBody: One note a month on finding tools, moving goods and what it really costs. No noise.
footer.disclaimer: Product availability and prices are confirmed with the supplier before you pay. Transit times are estimates until quoted, and a quote holds until the date shown on it. Customs duties and taxes are set by the authorities and passed on at cost. Figures and customer stories on this page are illustrative. Trademarks belong to their owners.
